summary: Completed frontend testing for Homeland Regalia project detail page - background video autoplay, logo positioning, Specifications/Features tabs, and regression testing for Homeland Leisure Valley. All core features working except video lightbox.

critical_bugs.issue: Clicking video thumbnail (data-testid='detail-video-thumb') opens lightbox with an IMAGE instead of VIDEO iframe. The lightbox dialog renders an img element instead of the expected iframe with video.
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot watch the project video in the lightbox. The video thumbnail is clickable but shows a static image instead of playing the video.
critical_bugs.root_cause: The media array or videoLightboxIndex calculation may be incorrect, causing media[lightbox]?.type to not equal 'video' when the video thumbnail is clicked. The conditional check at line 307 (media[lightbox]?.type === 'video') is failing.
reproduction_steps: 2. Scroll to thumbnail strip below hero
3. Click the video thumbnail (has play icon and 'Video' label)
4. Lightbox opens but shows an image instead of video iframe

passed_tests: ✅ Background video autoplay on /projects/homeland-regalia - iframe with data-testid='detail-hero-video' exists with autoplay=1, mute=1, loop=1 parameters and pointer-events-none class
✅ Logo positioning - data-testid='detail-hero-logo' positioned to the LEFT and parallel to project title, no overlap
✅ Image thumbnails open lightbox dialog on click
✅ Specifications tab (data-testid='tab-specifications') renders with content (data-testid='specifications-content') showing land area, unit area, floor count, and specifications paragraph
✅ Features tab (data-testid='tab-features') renders with content (data-testid='features-content') showing Internal Features and External Features sections
✅ Enquiry form in sidebar renders with all fields (name, phone, email) and submit button, all fields are fillable
✅ Regression: /projects/homeland-leisure-valley has NO background video iframe (correct)
✅ Regression: homeland-leisure-valley has NO Specifications/Features tabs (auto-hidden, correct)
✅ Regression: homeland-leisure-valley shows static hero image with logo on left (correct)
✅ Regression: homeland-leisure-valley Overview/Amenities/Location tabs work correctly

success_percentage.note: 9 out of 10 test scenarios passed. Only video lightbox functionality failed.

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix video lightbox bug: When clicking video thumbnail (data-testid='detail-video-thumb'), the lightbox should display the video iframe but currently shows an image. Debug the media array construction and videoLightboxIndex calculation in ProjectDetail.js lines 29-42 and the conditional rendering at lines 307-310. Verify that media[videoLightboxIndex] has type='video' when the video thumbnail is clicked.
